description: Return one section's text, resolved by docguard:section id, then heading anchor, then exact heading text — or, with `line`, just the lines around one reference from docguard_docs_for_path (the cheapest read for a table row). Bounded: 8192 bytes by default, 32768 at most; a truncated result carries nextOffset. An ambiguous match fails with the candidates.

context.description: With line: lines before and after (default 3)

line.description: Read the lines around this line number instead of a whole section

offset.description: Byte offset from a previous truncated read

projectDir.description: Project to inspect: a directory inside the directories this server serves (absolute, or relative to the served directory). Defaults to the served directory.

name: docguard_read_section
title: Read one section of a document
